♡Family Today♡

Claire has the cover: Friday night football, the storm clouds breaking into a sunset over the field. The good weekend is here: sunny and 63 today, 68 tomorrow. Sunday is a full day on the couch if you want it: Bills and Patriots at 1:00, Jets at Chicago at 1:00, then Las Vegas at 5:30. Tomorrow's paper runs long.

  • Oct 4Las Vegas, NASCAR playoffs — 5:30, USA
  • Oct 23Claire's birthday
  • Oct 25Garret and Ariel's birthday

Had a migraine? Log it at tally.so/r/obWNYP — who, the day, roughly when — and the paper will mark it on the Barograph. Enough entries and we will see what the pressure does before one hits.

🍂The Turning🍂

The high country goes first. Our trees usually reach peak color in the last week of October. The next state report comes Wednesday.

☾The Almanac Sky☾

Last quarter this morning, half lit and in Cancer, rising just after midnight.
Sun 7:15a – 6:53p · 11h 38m
Next new moon Sat, Oct 10 · Next full moon Mon, Oct 26
Tonight Clear and dark until the moon comes up after midnight. Saturn sits opposite the Sun this weekend, so it is up all night and at its brightest of the year.
Aries
The moon in Cancer squares Saturn in your sign, to within a degree. Home wants more of your time than the calendar says it has. Give it the afternoon. Kaylani, Luka
Cancer
Last-quarter moon in your sign, squaring the Sun. The halfway point. Finish one thing before you start the next. Gregg
Leo
Mars in Leo sextiles Uranus. The plan you make up on the spot beats the careful one today. Leah, Tommy
Virgo
Your ruler Mercury is still squared by Mars and Pluto. Double-check the weekend plans before everybody commits. Derek, Joanne
Scorpio
Venus in your sign gets a trine from the moon. Warmth comes easy. Spend it on the people at your own table. Ariel, Claire, Garret

✶The Ledger✶

Heating oil, per gallon, this winter
$6.27
The state energy office expects heating oil to average $6.27 a gallon this winter, up from $3.72 — nearly 70% more.

✶The National Wire✶

1

Hiring Slows to a Crawl

The economy added 29,000 jobs in September, far fewer than in August, and unemployment rose to 4.2%.

2

G7 Taps 100 Million Barrels

The big industrial nations will release 100 million barrels of oil and fuel from their reserves, starting with diesel, to bring prices down.

3

Hawaii's Sea Arch Is Gone

The 550-year-old Hōlei Sea Arch, a lava-rock landmark in Volcanoes National Park, collapsed into the Pacific some time last weekend.

☑ The Ballot · 31 days to Election Day · early voting Oct 24–Nov 1 · register by Oct 24

⛪The Home Wire⛪

1

Rochester · The Auto Show Ends After 118 Years

Organizers have discontinued the Rochester Auto Show, which dates to 1908.

2

Hilton · Apple Fest This Weekend

In the village of Hilton, northwest of Rochester in Monroe County, around the Community Center: today 10 to 5, Sunday 10 to 4:30. Free parking and shuttles from Hilton High School, 400 East Ave. The 2024 festival drew more than 70,000.

3

Dunkirk · Water Rates Hold Up the Budget

Mayor Kate Wdowiasz says she can't offer her 2027 budget until the fight over proposed water rate increases is settled. Mayors usually present theirs in September.

★The Marquee★

1

Flutie Flakes Are Back

Nearly three decades after they first hit Buffalo shelves, Doug Flutie is bringing the cereal back to Western New York to support autism programs.

2

Pedro Pascal in Behemoth!

Tony Gilroy's first feature since 2012 casts Pascal as a classical cellist in a midlife crisis. Early reviews are split.

3

Stray Kids Join the Grammy Boycott

The K-pop group is following BTS in not submitting music this year, over the Recording Academy's new Best Asian Pop category.

🏈The Gridiron🏈

Tomorrow at 1:00
Bills · Nobody ruled out. Christian Benford (toe) and Ray Davis (hamstring) are questionable; T.J. Sanders (illness) is doubtful. New England will be without Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore.
Jets · Minkah Fitzpatrick is back to full practice. Breece Hall, Mason Taylor, Adonai Mitchell, Dylan Parham and Kiko Mauigoa are out. Chicago is short too: Caleb Williams is out with a hamstring, and the Bears haven't named a starter.
